falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes at least 3.0% above the signal-date close on any session in the next 14 days, and that breakout close is not fully retraced within the next 3 sessions.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini_top_2019_jun analog and HOLD are wrong: price resolved into a sustained upside break, so UNKNOWN was not an indecision state but a missed continuation.

falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes at least 5.0% below the signal-date close within 14 days and VIX closes above 24 on the same day or the following session.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: UNKNOWN/HOLD is invalidated because the path already completed as a risk-off top: the correct call was downside, not an unresolved hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 75, or at or below 35, on 3 consecutive daily readings within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 55 score was not a stable ambiguous regime; leaving the 35–75 band forces a directional blowoff or no-blowoff verdict and falsifies UNKNOWN.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
